title: Girl in Swimsuit Sitting on Porch Railing, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot depicting a young barefoot girl in a dark swimsuit lounging on a white wooden porch railing, leaning back against the siding of a home. Beside her, the legs of another companion are visible enjoying the sunny day, with post-war suburban houses and a sidewalk stretching in the background. The print features decorative deckled scalloped edges and binder-punch holes at the top.
